result.instructions: Tools for Campaign Monitor, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our lists lost the most subscribers this month?"; "How did our last sent campaign perform: opens, clicks and bounces?"; "Is jane@example.com subscribed to our newsletter list, and when did she join?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Campaign Monitor data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run campaignmonitor_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run campaignmonitor_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run campaignmonitor_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. campaignmonitor_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients (client accounts) the API key can see, with their ClientID and Name. Start here to find a client id. Campaign Monitor API: GET /clients.json.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_client_lists
tools.title: List subscriber lists
tools.description: List the subscriber lists of one client, with their ListID, name and unsubscribe settings. Use a ListID with the list and subscriber tools. Campaign Monitor API: GET /clients/{clientID}/lists.json.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the email templates of one client, with their TemplateID, name and preview URLs. Campaign Monitor API: GET /clients/{clientID}/templates.json.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_suppression_list
tools.title: Get suppression list
tools.description: List the email addresses that a client has suppressed (blocked from sending), with the date and reason. Campaign Monitor API: GET /clients/{clientID}/suppressionlist.json.

orderfield.description: Field to sort by, for example email, name or date. Vendor default when left out.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_list
tools.title: Get a list
tools.description: Get one subscriber list's details: name, unsubscribe page, confirmed opt-in and bounce settings. Campaign Monitor API: GET /lists/{listID}.json.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_list_stats
tools.title: Get list statistics
tools.description: Get the totals for one list: active, unsubscribed, bounced and deleted subscriber counts, and the list's growth figures. Campaign Monitor API: GET /lists/{listID}/stats.json.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_active_subscribers
tools.title: List active subscribers
tools.description: List the active (subscribed) subscribers of one list, page by page, with email, name, joined date and custom fields. Campaign Monitor API: GET /lists/{listID}/active.json.

orderfield.description: Field to sort by, for example email, name or date. Vendor default when left out.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_unsubscribed_subscribers
tools.title: List unsubscribed subscribers
tools.description: List the subscribers who unsubscribed from one list, with the date they left. Campaign Monitor API: GET /lists/{listID}/unsubscribed.json.

orderfield.description: Field to sort by, for example email, name or date. Vendor default when left out.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_bounced_subscribers
tools.title: List bounced subscribers
tools.description: List the subscribers whose address bounced on one list, with the bounce type and date. Campaign Monitor API: GET /lists/{listID}/bounced.json.

orderfield.description: Field to sort by, for example email, name or date. Vendor default when left out.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get a subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber on a list by email address: state (active, unsubscribed, bounced), name, custom fields and tags. Campaign Monitor API: GET /subscribers/{listID}.json?email=.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_sent_campaigns
tools.title: List sent campaigns
tools.description: List the sent campaigns of one client, with CampaignID, subject, sent date and recipient counts. Use a CampaignID with the campaign report tools. Campaign Monitor API: GET /clients/{clientID}/sent.json.

orderfield.description: Field to sort by, for example email, name or date. Vendor default when left out.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_scheduled_campaigns
tools.title: List scheduled campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns of one client that are scheduled to send, with CampaignID, subject and scheduled date. Campaign Monitor API: GET /clients/{clientID}/scheduled.json.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_draft_campaigns
tools.title: List draft campaigns
tools.description: List the unsent draft campaigns of one client, with CampaignID, name and subject. Campaign Monitor API: GET /clients/{clientID}/drafts.json.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_campaign_summary
tools.title: Get campaign summary
tools.description: Get the headline results of one sent campaign: recipients, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, spam complaints and the unique and total counts. Campaign Monitor API: GET /campaigns/{campaignID}/summary.json.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_campaign_opens
tools.title: List campaign opens
tools.description: List the subscribers who opened one sent campaign, with the open time and the number of opens. Campaign Monitor API: GET /campaigns/{campaignID}/opens.json.

orderfield.description: Field to sort by, for example email, name or date. Vendor default when left out.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_campaign_clicks
tools.title: List campaign clicks
tools.description: List the link clicks of one sent campaign: subscriber, clicked URL and click time. Campaign Monitor API: GET /campaigns/{campaignID}/clicks.json.

orderfield.description: Field to sort by, for example email, name or date. Vendor default when left out.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_campaign_bounces
tools.title: List campaign bounces
tools.description: List the bounced recipients of one sent campaign, with the bounce type and time. Campaign Monitor API: GET /campaigns/{campaignID}/bounces.json.

orderfield.description: Field to sort by, for example email, name or date. Vendor default when left out.

tools.name: campaignmonitor_get_campaign_unsubscribes
tools.title: List campaign unsubscribes
tools.description: List the subscribers who unsubscribed after one sent campaign, with the time they left. Campaign Monitor API: GET /campaigns/{campaignID}/unsubscribes.json.

orderfield.description: Field to sort by, for example email, name or date. Vendor default when left out.
